card.name: Partway through long medical terms
card.fires_on: Fires on the opening or middle piece of a longer medical word, such as 'red' in 'redness', 'lip' in 'lipodystrophy', or 'ational' in 'gestational'. The word is not yet complete when it fires.

modes.label: Start of skin or injection-site terms
modes.description: First piece of a word like redness or lipodystrophy in skin-reaction or injection-site text.

modes.label: Middle of long Latin-style terms
modes.description: Inner piece of a long technical word such as gestational, mutational, epigenetic or intraepithelial.

card.writes: It leans toward event-like words, but the suppressed tokens are unrelated, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires inside a long medical word that has not finished yet, such as lipodystrophy or gestational.
